title: feat(objectql, runtime)!: object-less action names held per namespace, and a call that names no package is refused in the two declared holder cases (ADR-0150 child B)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBDjNZzBTDGVQoXhCdngfjXY)_

Fixes #31697

Supersedes #32101

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — a call that names no package is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, naming every holder, where it ran one of them on base, in exactly the two declared cases (epic ruling 6762267053 item 1): two packages hold the action on one key (an object, or the object-less key; ruling 6729825528 letter A), and, on the object-less key only, a package's beside host code or a plugin's (the G2 obligation 6742974046). The doors: `ObjectQL.executeAction` with no `packageId`; the bare `POST /actions/:object/:action` and the MCP bare `run_action`; `GET /meta/action/NAME` for an object-less action; and, in process, the metadata service's own `get` / `getDiagnosed('action', NAME)` naming no package, for a name two packages hold on one key (an action is slotted by its identity, contract review G1). Refused at install: a package declaring the object-less action `install_package`, now a built-in name (epic ruling 6762267053 item 2 (b)), or an action `install_package` bound to `sys_package`, now a built-in key (epic answer G6). When the listing behind the bare `POST /actions/:object/:action` cannot be read, every bare call there answers `503` where it ran (G8). First-party count: 0. The install side widens: two packages of two namespaces may each declare one object-less action name. Console's bare calls to such a name answer 409 until Console carries the package.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Narrowing: yes — the refusals above; measured first-party 0 on showcase, crm and multi-package (census on #32101, unchanged); no first-party package declares `install_package`, object-less or bound to `sys_package` (census under G6 below).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：无对象动作按命名空间各持一个名字；不写包名的调用只在两种已申报情形下返回 409 并列出全部持有者（同一键上两个包；无对象键上包与宿主代码或插件并存），其余维持原状。元数据服务的内存仓把 action 按身份分槽：绑定对象的是「包 + 对象 + 名」，无对象的是「包 + 名」，所以两个包绑在不同对象上的同名动作互不相碰。
- 为什么改：合约复审 6769997881（8cf8c844，FAIL）的补丁轮 r2，修 G1、G4、G5、G7、G8，并执行史诗席位对 G3、G6 的答复（6770044061）。
- 风险与回滚：仍是收窄，首方计数为 0。本轮新增申报：绑定到 `sys_package` 的 `install_package` 在安装时拒绝；清单读不到时每个裸 REST 调用返回 503，且每次裸调用多读两次清单。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts` 的 `slotIdentityOf` 与 `readStoreEntry`，`packages/objectql/src/engine-actions.ts` 的 `unqualifiedHandler`，`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` 的 `bareRouteHolderRefusal` 与 `listingNotServed`，`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的 `refuseBareNameConflicts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run src/metadata-manager-action-slots.test.ts` 与 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/action-package-addressing.test.ts src/domains/actions-bare-door-topologies.test.ts`，应全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无；席位做合约复审，史诗席位只读增量。

## Patch round r2

This round answers the contract review 6769997881 (VERDICT FAIL at `8cf8c844`) and the epic seat's answers on G3 and G6 (comment 6770044061). It starts by merging `origin/main` at `0eca80a7` (`b4f77b2c`, no rebase): #32192 had landed, so `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` keeps every entry, `api`, `agent`, `skill` and this PR's `action`.

| Finding | Change | Pin (ablation) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **G1** (must-fix) | An action is slotted by its identity, not by its bare name (`package-slotted-store.ts`, `slotIdentityOf`). An action bound to an object is `(package, object, name)`; an object-less one is `(package, name)` and keys exactly as `api` does. D3 applies only inside one identity: two packages' same-named actions on two different objects never share a slot, and the metadata service's `get` / `getDiagnosed` naming no package does not refuse them. Only the object-less name, or one object and one name, is the two-holder case. For a name several identities hold, the read naming no package answers the slot written last (`recordStoreWrite`, the order the bare-name map kept), and is refused when any one identity is itself held by two packages. One package binding one name to two objects keeps both. The dogfood case that pinned the bare `GET /meta/action/NAME` first-registered pick is removed (see Acceptance notes). | `metadata-manager-action-slots.test.ts`, "[contract review G1]": two objects' pair both kept, each read by its package, the bare read not refused and answering the one written last (re-pinned after an overwrite); one object's pair refused naming both; one package on two objects keeps both; a bound action beside a two-holder object-less name is refused. A13: identity back to the bare name → 2 red. A14: no write order → 1 red. Dogfood `action-slotted-store-artifact.dogfood.test.ts`: the different-object pair on the artifact door, both kept, `?package=` each its own, the in-process bare read not refused, no pin on the bare HTTP body. |
| **G1, layered read** (`protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts` ~189) | The `catch { // ignore }` there swallows the metadata service's refusal, but the registry fallback it falls to refuses the same two holders, so the bare layered read of a name this PR refuses is refused too. No change needed. | Dogfood: bare `/meta/action/NAME/layers` of the two-holder object-less name → 409 naming both; `?package=` serves each package its own code layer. |
| **G4** | `unqualifiedHandler` (`engine-actions.ts`) leaves a disabled package's handler out of its holder count (`registry.isPackageDisabled`), so a disabled package never draws a 409. When the unqualified entry is the disabled package's own (it registered last), the enabled package's slot runs instead. The handler stays bound, so enabling the package again restores the refusal. `executeAction` reads the same registry. | `action-package-addressing.test.ts` "[contract review G4]": A and B both bind `approve`; B disabled → the bare resolve answers A and an actual `executeRegisteredAction` dispatch returns `ran A`; B enabled again → 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`. A16: count the disabled package again (objectql rebuilt under hold) → 1 red; restored and rebuilt, the file runs 20/20. |
| **G3** (epic answer) | The bare door fails closed on every served topology. The predicate is now the listing itself: `bareRouteHolderRefusal` judges nothing only when the merged listing fails with `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` naming `sys_metadata` anywhere in its `cause` chain (`listingNotServed`), never because the engine's schema lacks the object. Every other listing failure is `degraded` (503). Topologies measured: a standalone kernel (no `environmentId`) and an environment kernel (`MetadataPlugin` with `environmentId` and an artifact source, `ObjectQLPlugin` with `environmentId` and `hydrateMetadataFromDb`). Both register `sys_metadata` and serve the listing, and the door refuses two holders on both. **Limit:** the cloud's environment composition is not in this repository. A composition whose listing fails for want of `sys_metadata` judges nothing there, and its bare call falls through to the rungs as on base. | New `actions-bare-door-topologies.test.ts` (both kernel shapes): two holders → 409 naming both; CONTROL one holder → 200 from `com.qa.topa`; `sys_metadata` measured registered. `action-package-addressing.test.ts` "[contract review G3]": an engine whose schema lacks `sys_metadata` while its listing answers → still refused, candidates `[A, B]`. A17: the old schema predicate back → 1 red. |
| **G5** | `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` (was `added`), in the body and the changeset. Levels stay minor. | (declaration) |
| **G6** (epic answer) | The bound key is guarded too, and the object-less entry stays. `BUILT_IN_BOUND_ACTION_KEYS = {'sys_package:install_package'}` (`bare-name-one-holder.ts`). A package declaring an action `install_package` bound to `sys_package` is refused at install (`refuseBareNameConflicts`, `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`, naming the platform and suggesting the namespace-prefixed name), and the cold boot reports it (`sealBareNameHolders`). Declared narrowing: FROM installed TO refused. **Census:** the only fixed-name action requests in the platform's own code are the Console marketplace (`marketplaceApi.ts`) and the cloud connection (`cloud-connection-plugin.ts`). Both post `POST /actions/sys_package/install_package` to the cloud URL, and no source in this repository declares the action. First-party count: 0. This supersedes r1's note that two packages binding it would be refused only by ruling A's letter. | Request-family "[epic G6]": a package binding `install_package` to `sys_package` is refused with `action "install_package" bound to "sys_package"` and rename `alpha_install_package`; CONTROL bound to its own object, it installs; a cold boot of a platform package plus `gamma` warns naming gamma. A15: the guard's loop emptied → 1 red. |
| **G7** | `composeStacks`' collision is filed as #32245 and named in Acceptance notes. | (note) |
| **G8** | Cost: every bare `POST /actions/:object/:action` reads the protocol's merged `object` and `action` listings (two `getMetaItems` reads) beside the one schema and one by-name read it made on base, collision or not. The listing-outage 503 joins the BREAKING list in the changeset: FROM running the object's own declaration TO `503` for every bare call while the listing cannot be read, one-holder names included. | (declaration; the 503 is r1's F1 pin) |
| **Nits** | The Console follow-up sentence is refreshed: it is recorded on #31527 (comment 6767570817). The disabled-package sentence in the changeset now names `executeAction`. | (prose) |

Every ablation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, and each restore printed blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. A16 held the mutation, rebuilt `@objectstack/objectql`, ran the runtime pin, then restored and rebuilt.

## Patch round r1

Round r1 continued #32101 from its head `921ec56a` (merged with `origin/main` at `45f0f81f`, no rebase) and answers the contract review 6762242732 (VERDICT FAIL) and the epic rulings 6762108144 and 6762267053. #32101's body (census, positions, forced test changes, overlap) still holds except where this section says otherwise.

| Finding / ruling | Change | Pin (ablation) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **F1** (must-fix; epic 6762108144 "Deviation 1 must change") | `bareRouteHolderRefusal`: a capability that is absent judges nothing — no `protocol` with `getMetaItems` and no `metadata` service with `listObjects`/`loadMany`, a `resolveService` that does not resolve, or a protocol whose own engine registers no `sys_metadata` object (no store behind its listing; every served kernel registers it). Once the capability is there, a listing read that throws answers `degraded` (503), never the rungs. Measured on the first fail-closed draft: 31 runtime tests in 10 files went red. 28 compose a bare `ObjectQL` with no `sys_metadata` (their listing threw `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` for it); they fall through as before. One was this patch's own docblock spelling the object-less key as a literal (fixed). Two are `action-handler-owner-gates.test.ts`'s plane-down cases, a metadata service whose listing throws: they now expect 503, nothing run (forced test change; it ran the action's own handler before). | `actions-addressed-route.test.ts` "the bare door's holder rule when the listing read throws": protocol listing throws → 503, nothing run; metadata listing throws → 503; CONTROL no capability → the rungs answer. A3: `catch` back to `return undefined` → 2 red. |
| **F2** | With two or more declarations on the route's key, the bare REST door serves the declaration `pickActionHolder` chose, the one MCP's bare `run_action` serves. Declared in the changeset: a package's embedded action beside the environment's own stored row of the same object and name now answers the environment's on both doors (ADR-0150 D3); on base both answered the embedded one. The changeset sentence "then it answers first, as before" is corrected. | "an object-bound pair of a package's and the environment's: both bare doors serve the environment's": REST and MCP both answer the environment's gated declaration (403). A4: drop the served holder → red. |
| **F3** | `refuseAmbiguousObjectLessAction(name, readStoredRows)` classifies a package-less object-less item as the protocol's other doors do: the environment's only when the environment's store holds an active package-less row of the name that is itself object-less (the protocol's by-name row read, `readItemActiveRows`), else the platform's, refused beside a package naming both. It reads every package-less entry of the bare slot, because the registry reads one over a held name as that holder's overlay, which only the environment's row is. `readMetaItem` passes the reader. | runtime `action-package-addressing.test.ts` "[#31697 review F3]": host item beside a package → 409, candidates `[package A, platform]`; a stored row bound to an object does not make it the environment's. CONTROL (amended): the environment's own stored row answers first. A9 (objectql rebuilt under hold): platform branch never taken → red. |
| **F4** | A disabled package is no holder at `/meta/action/NAME`'s refusal (holders and items both filtered by `isPackageDisabled`), as the merged listings withhold it. The bare REST door's by-name rung reads a thrown `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` (or its 409 + `refusal` shape) as a refusal, never `degraded`. | "[#31697 review F4] a disabled package holds nothing": the bare read and the bare REST door answer the enabled holder, not degraded. "the bare REST door reads the by-name read's refusal as a refusal". A10 (both filters, objectql rebuilt under hold) → red; A7: refusal read as degraded again → red. |
| **F5** | The source classifier keys a stored row by its identity: a standalone row by `OWNER:NAME` (its owner key and name), an embedded row by `OBJECT:NAME` of an object row that embeds that action. It also leaves a legacy organization's rows out (`readLegacyOrganizationRows`), as the resync does, and reads the legacy plural `actions` when no `action` row exists. | "[review F5] a package-less row the store holds on ANOTHER object does not make this one the environment's". A5: match by bare name again → red. |
| **F6 / F7 + epic ruling 2 (a)** | The PR body (above) and the changeset declare under the widening: "Console's bare calls to such a name answer 409 until Console carries the package". The follow-up — Console addresses an action by its app's package (`useNavActionDispatch`'s `getItem('action', name)`, `consoleServerAction.ts`'s `/actions/OBJECT/ACTION` URL, the activation write in Setup's packaged actions) — belongs on #31527 per ruling 2 (a), not in a new issue; I did not file it. At this head #31527 does not record it yet (its comments through 6766935846 name no Console follow-up), so the epic seat records it. | (declaration only) |
| **Epic ruling 2 (b)** | Census of fixed-name action calls in the platform's own code (`packages/**/src`, `ui/**/src`, no tests): one, `POST /actions/sys_package/install_package` (`marketplaceApi.ts`, `cloud-connection-plugin.ts`). Every other Console action call is a name read from metadata. `install_package` joins `BUILT_IN_BARE_NAMES.action`, so no package can hold the object-less name that reaches `sys_package`'s route. The object-bound key `sys_package:install_package`: platform objects are referenceable, so a package can bind an action there; after ruling 1 a single package beside the platform's declaration is not refused, so one more holder never turns the button into a 409. Two packages both binding it would be refused by ruling A's letter (see Acceptance notes). | request-family "the action the platform's own UI calls by a fixed name is a built-in": the set is `['install_package']` and a package declaring it is refused naming the built-in. A8: empty the set → red. |
| **Epic ruling 1** (pull the engine back) | `unqualifiedHandler` refuses only two packages on one key, or, on the object-less key, a package beside host code or a plugin. Host code or a plugin beside ONE package on an object-bound key runs the last registration, as on base. Both #30542 pins in `plugin-authored-actions.test.ts` are restored byte for byte. The declaration doors follow the same scope: `pickActionHolder` counts the platform only on the object-less key; on an object-bound key beside a platform declaration the first declaration answers, as on base. | `bound-action-collision-report.test.ts` "on the object-less key, host code … refused" (A1 → red) and "on an object-bound key, host code or a plugin beside ONE package is not refused" (A2: refuse on any key → red); `actions-addressed-route.test.ts` "the platform beside one package on an object-bound key is not refused" (A6: count the platform on any key → red). |
| **Epic B-shape item 1** (6766935846; seat call) | `action` joins `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` beside `api` (`packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts`), in the same stroke as its `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` entry. Every rule the set drives was already in place for `api` (#32092). Measured on an artifact-door boot of two namespaces (base = the set entry ablated, metadata rebuilt): base answered every read the package registered last, and `/meta/action/NAME?package=alpha` served beta's body stamped alpha; head answers each package its own and lists both, and the in-process bare `get` of a two-holder name is 409 naming both. The store keys an action by its name, so two packages' same-named actions on two different objects are slotted too: their `?package=` reads are fixed the same way, and the bare `GET /meta/action/NAME` stays 200 but serves the package registered first (the registry's step) where it served the survivor. Declared in the changeset; `@objectstack/metadata` joins it (minor). | `metadata-manager-action-slots.test.ts`: both items kept, by-package reads each its own (plural spelling too), a non-holder nothing, bare `get`/`getDiagnosed` 409 `ambiguous-in-environment` naming both; CONTROLs one holder and a non-slotted type (`flow`). A11: set back to `['api']` → 4 red, both CONTROLs green. Dogfood `action-slotted-store-artifact.dogfood.test.ts` (artifact door): A12 (held, metadata rebuilt, the marker found in its dist) → 3 red, the one-holder CONTROL green; restored and rebuilt → 4/4. |
| B shape on the merge | `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` on `origin/main` holds `agent`, `skill`; this PR adds `action`. No other B card has landed since. | ai-family switch pin (unchanged from #32101). |

Every ablation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; each restore printed blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. A9 and A10 held the mutation, rebuilt `@objectstack/objectql`, ran the runtime pin, restored and rebuilt; the runtime file then ran 18/18.

## Acceptance notes

- **The bare `GET /meta/action/NAME` of two packages' same-named actions on two different objects** is #32244's (its step 2 catch: `readMetaItem` swallows a metadata-service throw and falls to the registry's step). This PR does not pin which body it serves. The in-process metadata service does not refuse that pair and answers the slot written last (G1).
- **`composeStacks` lags the widening** (found by the dogfood): composing two stacks that each declare the same object-less action refuses with `StackComposeActionKeyCollisionError`, though the engine keeps one handler slot per package. Filed as #32245. The dogfood keeps each package's body apart in the compiled artifact instead.
- **Removal by slot** (epic B-shape item 2): not built here. It rides #32198, the generic mechanism (`unregisterPackage` / `unregisterAt` by `(package, name)`), never a per-type fork.
- **Two packages binding `install_package` to `sys_package`**: superseded by G6. Every package binding it is now refused at install, the first included.
- **A host (package-less) action item over a package-held name reads back as that package's overlay** at `?package=`: that is ADR-0150 D4 by design (a package-less row bearing a package-held name is the holder's customization), not a defect.
- **Epic B-shape item 4**: `action` has no metadata redactor (only connector, datasource and flow register one), so `readCodeLayerForCarryForward` is never reached for it. **Item 5**: r1's F4 withholds a disabled package at the by-name door, and G4 does the same at the engine; the install gate is unchanged and keeps counting it.
- **Console follow-up (ruling 2 (a))**: recorded on #31527, comment 6767570817. The body's declaration stands.
- **G3 topology limit**: see G3 above. The cloud composition is outside this repository.
